title: Amendments CIII and CIV to the Constitution of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina

AMENDMENTS CIII AND CIV TO THE
CONSTITUTION OF THE FEDERATION OF BOSNIA
AND HERZEGOVINA
“Official Gazette of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina”, 20/04
NOTE: Constitution of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina was published in the “Official Gazette of the
Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina”, 1/94.

Pursuant to Amendment L to the Constitution of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, the Parliament of
the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, at the sessions of the House of Representatives, held on 24 March,
2004 and 13 April, 2004, and at the session of the House of Peoples, held on 14 April, 2004, adopted
DECISION
promulgating Amendment CIII and Amendment CIV
to the Constitution of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina
I
Amendments CIII and Amendment CIV to the Constitution of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina
adopted by the Parliament of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina at the sessions of the House of
Representatives, held on 24 March 2004 and 13 April, 2004, and at the session of the House of Peoples, held on
14 April, 2004, are hereby promulgated.
II
Amendment CIII and Amendment CIV to the Constitution of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina shall
enter into force at midnight, 14 April, 2004.
III
The Decision shall be published in the Official Gazette of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina.
PF No. 01, 02-01-53/04

Sarajevo

Pursuant to Amendment L to the Constitution of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, the Parliament of
the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, at the sessions of the House of Representatives, held on 24 March,
2004 and 13 April, 2004, and at the session of the House of Peoples, held on 14 April, 2004, adopted
AMENDMENT CIII AND AMENDMENT CIV TO THE CONSTITUTION OF
THE FEDERATION OF BOSNIA AND HERZEGOVINA
AMENDMENT CIII
Article IV.C.4.(4) of the Constitution of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina shall be amended, to read as
2

follows:
“(4) The High Judicial and Prosecutorial Council of Bosnia and Herzegovina, as a State-level body, shall ensure
autonomy, independence, impartiality, competence and efficiency of the judiciary and of the prosecutorial
service in the Federation. The responsibilities of the High Judicial and Prosecutorial Council shall include, but
shall not be limited to, the appointment, discipline and removal of judges, apart from the Judges of the
Constitutional Court of the Federation, and shall also include prosecutors and deputy prosecutors in the
Federation. The composition and additional responsibilities of the High Judicial and Prosecutorial Council shall
be defined by law of Bosnia and Herzegovina.”
AMENDMENT CIV
Article VI.3 shall be amended to read as follows:
“1. Each Municipality shall have a Municipal Council and a Head of Municipality.
2. The term of the members of Municipal Councils and of the Head of Municipality shall be four years.
3. Municipal Councillors and the Head of Municipality shall be elected democratically by voters in a
direct and secret Municipality-wide election, as provided by law.
4. In accordance with law, any voter shall be eligible to serve as a Municipal Councillor or Head of
Municipality.
5. The Head of Municipality and the Chairperson of the Municipal Council in a Municipality or a
Municipal Council of a multiethnic structure may not come from among the same constituent
peoples or from among the Others, except in those Municipalities in which one constituent people
makes up more than 80% of the population, according to the last Census in Bosnia and
Herzegovina.”
In Article VI.4, previous Item “(b)” shall be deleted and Items “(c)” and “(d)” shall become “(b)” and “(c)”.
